details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2600-2608 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The state_unavailable branch in rb_judge_merge_retry_transient sets RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="true" but leaves SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE (and SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_BLOCKERS) unchanged. When every retry read is unreadable, the mergeability_pending message at lines 2834-2842 / 2841 (merge site) and 2969-2977 / 2976 (terminal site) therefore shows a stale value such as "mergeable_state=clean", and rb_judge_deferred_merge_pending (2652-2667) empties the direct-merge stderr file that held the 5xx error.
  WHY: During a GitHub 5xx episode the operator log names a stale mergeable_state as the cause and the real error is lost; the mergeability_pending status itself is correct, so this is a diagnostics problem only. All reviewers rated it NIT; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2822-2833,2957-2968 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP="not_open", both sites build the closed-PR object with jq -cn '{state: "closed", draft: false, head: {sha: $sha}, base: {ref: $base}}', which has no closed_at, and the retry read at line 2567 never selects .closed_at. The skip line therefore logs closed_at=- and stage=pre_merge, although the check runs after a merge attempt.
  WHY: Goal 3 and the agents.d fragment require an ISO closed_at for pr_closed, so operators and log parsers get "-" on this reachable path. All reviewers rated it NIT; confidence ranged from 4 to 5.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2828-2831,2963-2966 (fallback stub 281-290) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When pr_checks_lib.sh did not load, declare -F _pr_merge_state_check finds the fallback stub. The stub ignores the closed-PR object it is passed and logs reason=pr_state_unavailable for a PR the retry confirmed as closed.
  WHY: Nothing merges, because the stub fails closed. But the log gives the wrong reason code and, per glm, a held lease is not released. minimax also notes that this is inconsistent with the review_autofix.yml stub, which returns 0 for stage=start. Rated NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4353 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When pr_checks_lib.sh fails to load, the fallback stub for _pr_merge_state_check prints "reason=pr_state_unavailable" for a PR that is already known to be closed.
  WHY: The reported reason is wrong, but the PR still correctly fails to merge, so the fail-closed requirement holds. Rated NIT.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2770-2782 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In _mt_final_ci_merge_resume, the freshness gate _pr_base_fresh_for_merge (lines 2770-2771) runs before the state guard _pr_merge_state_check (lines 2781-2782).
  WHY: The freshness helper can take the merge lease or update the branch before the PR is confirmed open, which breaks the task intent. Rated BLOCKER. The same ordering is raised as a MAJOR task gap by minimax and luna; anthropic and glm explicitly did not re-report it, citing the prior editor's acceptance and the one-extra-call cap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, the closed-during-retry (not_open) branches at 2828-2831 (merge site) and 2963-2966 (terminal site), fed from the per-attempt read in rb_judge_merge_retry_transient at line 2567
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both branches build the object with jq -cn '{state: "closed", draft: false, head: {sha: $sha}, base: {ref: $base}}' with no closed_at; the @tsv read at line 2567 selects only state, merged, auto_merge, head.sha, mergeable_state and base.ref; _pr_merge_state_check (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4402-4433) prints "closed_at=- stage=pre_merge"; the agents.d fragment says closed_at is set only for pr_closed; no hunk passes the close timestamp on this path; lease release and RB_MERGE_STATUS=not_open are correct (all rated NIT; glm notes the documented <iso|-> format permits "-")
- requirement: "The same check runs when the job starts and when it takes or asks for the merge lease, so a closed PR does not take the lease, does not update its branch and does not wait on checks."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_final_ci_merge_resume, before _pr_base_fresh_for_merge (or inside _pr_base_fresh_for_merge before any _merge_lease_* write or branch update)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: _pr_base_fresh_for_merge runs at lines 2769-2771 and _pr_merge_state_check only afterwards at 2781-2782; the freshness helper can take a lease (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh ~2270, ~2311) or request a branch update (~2290-2298) and can return before the state check on the overlap/update path; the open-PR listing is a snapshot, not a recheck; the last-run diff moved the state read from before the freshness gate to after it (both rated MAJOR)
- requirement: "Every job that merges a PR … proceeds only when `state == "open"`, the PR is not a draft, and the head SHA equals the SHA the job is bound to."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The retry read at line 2567 does not select .draft; the retry checks state and head, then can issue gh pr merge --auto at lines 2596-2611 without re-checking draft status (rated NIT)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 2600-2608 (the state_unavailable branch in rb_judge_merge_retry_transient sets RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="true"), then lines 2834-2842 (the mergeability_pending branch at the merge site; the terminal site has the same branch). | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When all retry reads are unreadable after 5xx failures, the site prints "merge deferred and auto-merge not enabled; GitHub reports mergeable_state=clean (blockers: none)" from a stale SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE, and rb_judge_deferred_merge_pending empties the direct-merge stderr file (line 2654).
  WHY: The mergeability_pending status is right, but the log shows the wrong cause and the 5xx error is erased. Diagnostics only; nothing is merged wrongly.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, not_open branches (merge site lines 2822-2833 and the matching terminal-site branch); value from the per-attempt read in rb_judge_merge_retry_transient (line 2567).
  Evidence of absence: jq -cn '{state: "closed", draft: false, head: {sha: $sha}, base: {ref: $base}}' has no closed_at; the @tsv read at line 2567 never selects closed_at; _pr_merge_state_check (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh) prints "reason=pr_closed closed_at=- stage=pre_merge"; stage=pre_merge is also wrong after a merge attempt. Lease release and RB_MERGE_STATUS=not_open are correct.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOT REPORTED (notes, 3 related items): the merge-train resume ordering in scripts/review_merge_train.sh (lines 2769-2785) is accepted (the read is now the last call before gh pr merge; the one-extra-call cap applies; the prior editor accepted the window); the fallback-stub pr_state_unavailable wording is not reported (log wording only); the RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED follow-on cases were traced (the guard resets at line 2505; not_open and head_moved paths checked), and no real failure is hidden as mergeability_pending. cancel_on_pr_close.yml PR_MERGED default is OK.
- HARDENING (2 related items, risk score 1): add (.closed_at // "-") as a seventh @tsv field at line 2567 and pass it into the jq -cn object in both not_open branches (~5 lines); set SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE="unreadable" in the state_unavailable branch at lines 2600-2608 (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
